topics.title: Google Ads 法国和意大利附加费 2027-01-01 起升到 3%：先按展示地查账单，不是按公司注册地
topics.angle: 本轮已打开 PPC Land 11/22 原文，并打开 Google Ads 官方帮助页 answer/9750227。官方确认三处同一天生效：法国 Regulatory Operating Cost 2%→3%，意大利 2.5%→3%，土耳其 4.5%→2.25%。计费按广告展示地，不按公司注册地；帮助页写明 Google will not refund 因合法定向产生的这笔费用。附加费在出价之外，按国家出现在发票和 Transactions。30 分钟动作：1）打开账户 Transactions / 发票，看现在有没有 France / Italy / Turkey 附加费行，确认你是不是已经在给这些市场付费；2）若并不打算做法、意流量，检查活动地理定向和位置排除，避免「兴趣地点」把广告送到这些国家；3）若本来就做这两个市场，用现在的花费乘上新费率（法 +1.0 个百分点，相对现行 2% 是 +50%；意 +0.5 个百分点）估一版 2027 年 CAC，不要等 1 月才发现发票变了。不要写成「欧盟统一加税 3%」——西班牙已是 3%，英国/奥地利是另一套 DST，土耳其是下调。帮助页无更新日期；PPC Land 称 Payments 通知已发出，本轮未打开那封邮件本身。

topics.title: Merchant Center 的 consumer_notice 最多 7 条：第 8 条会覆盖第 1 条，Prop 65 商品先核对顺序

topics.title: Amazon Attribution 加 ASIN 据报会重述过去 28 天：黑五前先导出报表并核对后台说明

topics.title: Amazon Brand Store 新建页据报会先弹出 Builder Agent：先找退出入口，并核对 All Deals 是否自动填折扣商品
topics.angle: 本轮已打开 PPC Land 11/22 原文。帮助页（PPC Land 称更新于 11/11）把 Brand Store Builder Agent 放在 Add page 的默认路径上：点 Add page 会先打开 agent 窗口，可选 6 条预写 prompt 或自己写指令；生成后仍要人工 Save、编辑、Publish。退出方式是右上角「Add page without AI assistance」或左侧 X。另一条限制：可以任何语言跟 agent 聊，但页面按该 marketplace 主语言生成。审核可能要 3 个工作日，黑五前临时改页要算上这段等待。同一组帮助页（更新戳 11/21）还写 All Deals 标签页会按三个主题自动填最多 30 个折扣商品，品牌可以关掉或换成自己的 deals 页——旺季若不想让平台自动挑选折扣货盘，这是 30 分钟内能查的开关。本轮打开 Amazon Ads 帮助页时正文为空，以上步骤与限额均来自 PPC Land 对帮助页的摘录，不是直接读到的官方正文。这与 11/19 的 Product Selector 测验限额（50 个 ASIN / 4 题）不是同一功能，不复用那条 slug。 在登录后台看到同一入口之前，不要把「点 Add page 必出 Agent」写成已经确认的全量默认路径。

drafts.text:
Google will raise the Regulatory Operating Cost on ads served in France and Italy to 3% on January 1, 2027.

That means three things.

First, it follows where the ad is served, not where your company is registered. If you reach people in those countries, you pay it.

Second, it sits outside the bid. Look for a per-country line on the invoice or in Transactions.

Third, Google's help page says it will not refund charges that came from legitimate targeting. If you do not intend to serve France or Italy, check location settings now. If you do, model the new rate into 2027 CAC: France moves from 2% to 3%, Italy from 2.5% to 3%. Turkey, on the same date, falls from 4.5% to 2.25%.

Source: Google Ads help page on jurisdiction-specific surcharges, via PPC Land (Nov 22).

drafts.text:
Most people will treat Google's new consumer_notice field as a place to dump every legal line they have.

That is the wrong way to use it.

Merchant Center allows up to 7 notices per product, each up to 1,000 characters, typed as legal_disclaimer, safety_warning, or prop_65. If you submit 8, the official help page says the 8th overwrites the 1st, leaving notices 2 through 8.

There is also a wording split you should not paper over: the help page says the field is optional for all products; Google's UCP Merchant Center guide says it is mandatory for items with regulatory warning requirements, such as California Prop 65.

A 30-minute check: export the SKUs that carry warnings, count the notices, and put the legally required ones where they cannot be overwritten.

Sources: Google Merchant Center help on consumer_notice, and the UCP merchant-center guide.

drafts.text:
If you add ASINs to an Amazon Attribution brand this week, you may not get a stable Black Friday number until mid-December.

PPC Land quotes Amazon's help page: new ASINs take 4 to 7 business days to approve, then Amazon restates the previous 28 days of historical data, with corrections running about three weeks. The page does not say whether that restatement is sales, attributed conversions, or both.

I could not load the Amazon Ads help page body in this run (the official URL returned an empty document), so this is second-hand from PPC Land's excerpt, not a page I read directly.

The practical move is simple: export today's Attribution reports first, then check the help text in your own account before changing the ASIN list. Do not pause a necessary catalog update on a secondary-source excerpt alone.

Source: PPC Land, Nov 22.
